note: Machine-readable index of C:\tools and related CLIs. risk: read = changes nothing; write = creates/edits files; destructive = deletes or changes system state; admin = needs elevation. Use `tools find <word>` or `tools show <name>`; `tools doctor` verifies every entry still runs.

tools.name: es
tools.purpose: Instant file search across all drives via Everything (needs Everything running)

tools.name: pc-check
tools.purpose: Read-only PC health report: disks, SSD, Defender, battery, power plan, uptime, RAM, startup apps
tools.tip: run this first for any 'is my PC ok / slow / low on space' question

tools.name: pc-care
tools.purpose: Weekly upkeep: deletes %TEMP% files older than 7 days, prunes uv cache, health check, notifies only on problems
tools.tip: -Check makes it read-only; log in C:\tools\_logs\pc-health.txt

tools.name: pc-10.ps1
tools.purpose: One-time hardening (Defender PUA/network protection, SSD trim, update scan, weekly task, BitLocker/Secure Boot report)
tools.tip: needs UAC approval from the user; do not run unattended

tools.name: toolbox
tools.tip: prefer pc-check for read-only status

tools.name: autorunsc64
tools.purpose: List everything that starts with Windows (Sysinternals)
tools.tip: needs admin for a full list

tools.name: btop
tools.tip: interactive: not for non-interactive agents; use pc-check

tools.name: bleachbit
tools.tip: portable copy; always --preview first and ask before --clean
